0.$description: Not a ramp step (docs/prd.md §8.3 names nine: 4–44) — zero carries no designed space to choose between. Added because Tailwind v4's `inset`/`top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left`/`translate` utility families look up their numeric value against this same `--spacing-*` namespace and, unlike `p-0`/`m-0` (which Tailwind special-cases to `0px` regardless of theme), do not fall back when the exact key is missing: confirmed by running `inset-0`/`top-0`/`translate-x-0` with no `--spacing-0` present — each resolved to `auto`/`none` rather than `0px`, silently collapsing any `fixed inset-0` overlay to a 0×0 element. First hit by Modal's own scrim (LDS-040), but blocks every future overlay the same way. Flagged in the PR.

44.$description: Spacing ramp step 44. docs/prd.md §8.3's prose names eight steps (4–32), but reference/harvest-tokens.mjs's own SPACING_RAMP set — the authority the token-decisions ticket harvests against — already treats 44 as a ninth step, and the harvest report maps real padding/margin occurrences onto it. Added to close that gap, not a new decision.
